title: UI风格#37 - Ancient Temple (古寺禅韵)
description: 创建第37种UI风格：古寺禅韵风格 - 中式古典、水墨山水、瓦当纹样。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planAK.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Temple style When color palette Then features ink blacks, rice whites, cinnabar red, bronze gold
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#1A1A1A (墨), #F5F5DC (宣纸), #8B0000 (朱砂), #B8860B (古铜), #2F4F4F (青墨)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Temple style When typography Then uses classical Chinese: Ma Shan Zheng, Noto Serif SC, or ZCOOL QingKe HuangYou

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Temple style When layout Then classical Chinese composition, ink wash borders, traditional patterns
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：中式构图、水墨边框、传统纹样、瓦当图案

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Temple style When UI elements Then traditional patterns, ink wash effects, red seal stamps

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Temple UI When functional Then includes scroll chat, monk agents, incense stats
